citation: O.C.G.A. 12-8-79; Ga. L. 1979, p. 1127, s. 21 (Georgia Hazardous Waste Management Act)
quote: no action, ordinance, regulation or law of any county, municipality or other political subdivision shall operate to prevent the location or operation of a hazardous waste facility holding a valid Hazardous Waste Facility Permit
conditions: Narrow: applies only to hazardous waste treatment, storage or disposal facilities that hold a state permit; not general heavy industry or chemical plants.
The same section lets a local government challenge a facility's compliance with the Act or its permit.

Primary-host exception: the URL is the Digital Library of Georgia scan of the 1979 session laws (University System of Georgia), not the legislature's own site, which has no copy of the 1979 act. The current codified text of O.C.G.A. 12-8-79 was not read.
Effective upon approval by the Governor (Section 24); approved April 16, 1979.

quote: No governmental entity of this state shall adopt any policy that restricts or prohibits, or has the effect of restricting or prohibiting, based on the type or source of energy or fuel to be delivered or the appliance to be used:
conditions: Preempts fuel-type bans on LP gas connection and sales of liquefied petroleum gas. It does not mention zoning, siting or bulk storage, so local zoning of LP gas facilities is not shown to be preempted; the effect value is a judgement call (the Florida row for a similar statute is none_found).
